zh: 问题都会被解决。
en: Problem will be solved.

zh: 心怀感谢使你富足。
en: Expressing gratitude will bring you richness.

zh: 你的丰盛是无限的。
en: Your richness is unlimited.

zh: 给予和接受同等重要。
en: Giving and receiving are equally important.

zh: 一切皆在顺利的发展。
en: Everything is going as it should.

zh: 在我之内，你是安全的。
en: You are safe next to me.

zh: 生命的力量就在这一秒。
en: The power of life is in this second.

zh: 留意身体带给你的讯息。
en: Pay attention to what your body tells you.

zh: 你活在丰盛富足的世界里。
en: You live in a world of abundance.

zh: 当你快乐，丰盛随之而来。
en: When you are happy abundance follows.

zh: 现在的你就是最适合当下的你。
en: You are perfectly suited for this moment.

zh: 感谢你的身体，它强大并充满能量。
en: Be grateful for your body that provides you energy and vitality.

zh: 让自己好好放松，不需要有罪恶感。
en: Allow yourself to relax without feeling guilty.

zh: 慢下来，让身体扎根连接大地的养分。
en: Slow down and connect with the nutrients of the earth.

zh: 专注落实你的想法，我将为你带来资源。
en: Focus on implementing your ideas and I will bring you resources you require.

zh: 专注做你喜悦的事，就在吸引丰盛的到来。
en: You attract others simply by focusing on doing the things you love.

zh: 到大自然中接受大地之母对你的疗愈和慈爱。
en: Mother nature's loving embrace will heal you.

zh: 你认为自己有多少价值，就会拥有多少丰盛。
en: Your abundance reflects your assessment of self-worth.

zh: 关照你与家人的连结，这是丰盛和爱的入口。
en: Take care of your relationship with your family is the entrance to abundance and love.

zh: 给自己与生命一些空间与耐心，去经历成长、开花、结果。
en: Give yourself and your life some space and patience to experience growth, blossom and fruition.

zh: 你就在爱中。
en: You are in love.

zh: 一切都出自爱。
en: Love creates everything.

zh: 仁慈的善待自己。
en: Be kind to yourself.

zh: 爱是双向平衡的。
en: Love is a double down balance.

zh: 接受是转化的开始。
en: Acceptance is the beginning of conversion.

zh: 欣赏自己、肯定自己。
en: Appreciate and affirm yourself.

zh: 为自己设定安全尺度的责任。
en: You need to draw your own boundaries.

zh: 新的观点，能激发你的创造力。
en: New perspectives can spark your creativity.

zh: 让情感的流动，连结与爱的关系。
en: Cultivate love in your relationships and let your emotions flow.

zh: 给予爱与接受爱是自在而无负担的。
en: Giving and receiving love is nature and unburden.

zh: 感受你的生理需求，呵护并滋养它。
en: Feel your physical needs cherish and nourish it.

zh: 完完全全地交出自己，坠落时我会接住你。
en: Completely surrender yourself and I will catch you if you fall.

zh: 让不合适的离开，新的开始才能展开。
en: Disregard what is unnecessary and a new beginning will unfold.

zh: 尊重每个个体都有自己选择的生命蓝图。
en: Respect that every individuals has the right to choose their own lifes.

zh: 打开心，爱与关怀才能流进你的生命里。
en: Open your heart so love and caring flows into your life.

zh: 不要害怕给予爱会失去自己，好好去体验爱。
en: Don't be afraid to lose yourself by giving love just experience the feeling.

zh: 专注做你喜悦的事，就在吸引丰盛的到来。
en: You attract abundance by focusing on doing the things you love.

zh: 你期望世界是什么样的美好状态，就去成为那样美好的人。
en: Imagine a perfect world and then become the person who lives there.

zh: 允许自己可以有情绪，也可以有黑暗面，无条件接纳所有的你。
en: Accept yourself fully even your dark side.

zh: 力量在你之内。
en: The power is within you.

zh: 积极乐观地面对。
en: Face it with positivity and optimism.

zh: 别放弃，继续前进。
en: Do not give up. Keep moving forward.

zh: 是时候展开行动了。
en: Take action now.

zh: 自信充满你的细胞。
en: confidence fills every pore of your body.

zh: 用行动带动整体能量。
en: Use action to drive overall energy.

zh: 你拥有生命的主导权。
en: You control your own life.

zh: 让你的魅力大放光彩。
en: Let your charm shine through.

zh: 只有你能让自己快乐。
en: Only you can make yourself happy.

zh: 果决行动，谦卑待人。
en: Be humble and act decisively.

zh: 相信你的选择是正确的。
en: Believe in your own choices.

zh: 去体验与创造你所喜悦的。
en: To experience and create what pleased you.

zh: 你可以的，你已经足够强大。
en: You are strong enough to do what you need to do.

zh: 别怀疑自己，我信任你的能力。
en: I trust your ability so please do not doubt yourself.

zh: 信任自己，信任生命，信任宇宙。
en: Have trust in yourself in life and in universe.

zh: 你是自由的，无须任何框架的束缚。
en: You are free without any frame constraints.

zh: 别隐藏你的才华，将自己展现出来。
en: Present yourself and do not conceal your talent.

zh: 你已具备实现梦想的条件，迈开脚步去实践。
en: Take steps to make your dreams come true.

zh: 来到面前的一切困境，都是你有能力去突破的。
en: You can overcome all your difficulties.

zh: 做好眼前最重要的事，贵人与资源会自动到来。
en: Do the most important thing for every moment and the right people and resources will come to you automatically.

zh: 平衡并非静止不动，而是随时在变动中调整状态。
en: Balance is not static but adjust the state at any time in the change.

zh: 答案即将出现。
en: The answer will be revealed.

zh: 答案在内不在外。
en: The answer is within you not outside.

zh: 断舍的同时你也在获得。
en: You are gaining while you break away.

zh: 别怀疑，你一直在答案里。
en: Do not doubt you are always in the answer.

zh: 给他人自由等同于给自己自由。
en: Giving others freedom is the same as giving ourselves freedom.

zh: 请放手，让生命的伟大自然发生。
en: Relax and let life unfold in all its glory.

zh: 你就是你，无须成为别人眼中的你。
en: Be true to yourself not behaving the way you think others want to see.

zh: 新的开始，让爱与信任带领你飞翔。
en: Allow love and trust to lead you to a new beginning.

zh: 释放内在的恐惧，你正走在对的路上。
en: Let go of your fears for you are walking on the right path.

zh: 你的使命就是，将我对你的爱延续下去。
en: Your mission is to carry on my love for you.

zh: 放掉对结果的担忧，让信任的能量进来。
en: Allow in new energy and do not worry about the outcome.

zh: 将担忧交给我，让我将平安带到你的内心。
en: Discard your anxiety and allow me to bring you peace.

zh: 允许自己接受他人的帮助，是一种爱的循环。
en: Allowing yourself to accept help from others is a cycle of love.

zh: 将紧握的掌控交出去，让关系自由轻松的存在。
en: Let go of tight control and let the relationship develop freely and easily.

zh: 信任你所有的选择都有宇宙对你最高理想的安排。
en: Trust that all of your choices are planned by the universe for your highest ideals.

zh: 允许停下来沉淀与调整，能帮助你更有力量的前进。
en: Allowing yourself slow down and recognize it will help you move forward with more strength.

zh: 宽恕过去曾经犯下的错误，在我眼中你完美也完整。
en: Forgive past mistake because in my eyes you are perfect and complete.

zh: 你无须刻意追求光或成为光，因为你就是光的本体。
en: You don't need to seek light or be light deliberately because you are the essence of light.

zh: 为自己安排一段旅程，去发现与体验日常生活之外的事。
en: Arrange a journey for yourself to discover and experience life beyond the everyday.

zh: 没有白走的路，你所累积的经验会在对的时间点出现答案。
en: Your journey is not wasted for your accumulated experience will guide you appropriately.

zh: 尽情地去展现、去体验、去创造、去经历你所兴奋的一切。
en: Be creative and show yourself off experiencing all that excites you.

zh: 经历与割舍的过程未必舒服，请给自己多一点耐心，肯定与爱。
en: The process of living through experiences and letting go may be far from comfortable, give yourself more patience, affirmation, and love.

zh: 该是彻底改变的时刻了，别害怕蜕变的过程，那是你突破与重生的必经过程。
en: It's time for a complete change don't be afraid of the process of transformation which is a necessary process for your breakthrough and be reborn.

zh: 用祝福代替抱怨。
en: Replace complaints with blessing.

zh: 空，不是失去而是无限。
en: Empty not lost but infinite.

zh: 当你放下期待的去表达便充满力量。
en: It is powerful when you can let go of your expectations.

zh: 倾听你的感受，那是你灵魂的声音。
en: Listen to your feelings that is the voice of your soul.

zh: 设定你安全尺度的界限，在需要时说不。
en: Set boundaries and say NO when needed.

zh: 用心表达，你的话语是充满爱与力量的。
en: When you express yourself sincerely your words are full of love and strength.

zh: 表达是安全的，它是横跨两颗心的桥梁。
en: Expressions is safe it is a bridge across two hearts.

zh: 传送爱的能量去到你想倾诉内心的人心中。
en: Sound love to the heart of your special person.

zh: 静下来感受你的心跳，那是你和地球共振的频率。
en: Relax and listen to your heartbeat which is in synch with nature.

zh: 不受外在任何否定声音的干扰，专注内在的声音。
en: Shield yourself from external negativity and focus on your inner voice.

zh: 打开耳朵聆听周围细微的声音，感知生命，临在于此。
en: Be present and aware and listen to the subtle sounds around you.

zh: 你正在改变频率，吸引与你同频共振的人来到你的身边。
en: You are changing frequencies and attracting people who resonate with you to your surround.

zh: 在任何关系中，你都能在保有自己与彼此连接中取得平衡点。
en: In all relationships stay true to yourself while also connecting with others.

zh: 在关系中给予彼此保有舒适的空间，更能让爱和沟通得以自然流动。
en: Giving each other space allows love and communication to flow naturally.

zh: 觉察你用什么样的思想和语言，对待自己与周围，这些都在创造真相。
en: Observe how you use your thought and words and how you treat yourself and your surroundings these are all creating reality.

zh: 穿越冲突语言的表相，会帮助你看见情绪下有未被滋养的脆弱与真相。
en: Look beneath the surface of conflictual language and observe the vulnerability and truth in your fragile emotions.

zh: 静心感受你的呼吸以及自然万物的声音，都是我在向你表达爱你的话语。
en: Meditate feel your breath and listen to the sounds of nature for they are the embodiment of my love for you.

zh: 宽恕那些伤害你的行为和语言，让美好的爱与讯息有空间能进入你的生命里。
en: Forgive the actions and words that hurt you, making room for loving messages to enter your life.

zh: 相信你的直觉。
en: Trust your intuition.

zh: 让内在的神性带领你。
en: Let your soul guide you.

zh: 允许自己的光被看见。
en: Allow others to see your special light.

zh: 你所想的正在创造真相。
en: Reality is what you think it is.

zh: 你专注什么就会看见什么。
en: You will see what you focus on.

zh: 这个当下，你已经在创造未来。
en: At this moment you are already stepping into the future.

zh: 自由意志是你拥有的最大力量。
en: Free will is your greatest power.

zh: 用心去看见你的眼睛所没有发现的真相。
en: See with your heart what your eyes fail to see.

zh: 用爱的视角看见，每个生命个体的独特之处。
en: See the uniqueness of every being through the eyes of love.

zh: 让你生命独特的能量，为自己绽放并带给周围。
en: Allow yourself to blossom for yourself and for others.

zh: 真实的看见你的光，没有什么能阻挡你去闪耀。
en: Nothing can stop you from emitting your unique light.

zh: 大胆的展现自己，你的身上有我加披的神圣光芒。
en: Display yourself boldly for my divine light shines on you.

zh: 感受你的呼吸，这里蕴含着无限的希望，创造与力量。
en: Pay attention to your BREATH which contains unlimited hope, creativity and power.

zh: 记录你的灵感与想法，从共同点中整合你的创意去执行。
en: Take note of your own ideas and integrate them with commonly accepted beliefs.

zh: 打破旧有的惯性思维，敞开心的接收新的认知、新的领域。
en: Break old pattern of thought and open your heart to new influences.

zh: 传递你光与爱的能量，并分享你对生命的洞见给这个世界。
en: Radiate your light and love, and share your insight on life with the world.

zh: 你以爱与正向的心去看待生命，生命也将为你带来爱与正向的人。
en: You will be surrounded by loving and forward-looking people once you approach the world with a positive heart.

zh: 一切皆有可能。
en: Anything is possible.

zh: 爱让奇迹发生。
en: Love brings about miracles.

zh: 你是神圣的灵魂。
en: You are a divine soul.

zh: 幸运围绕在你周围。
en: Luck is all around you.

zh: 丰盛的恩典正流向于你。
en: Grace is flowing with you.

zh: 在我眼中，你是重要与美好的。
en: You are important and beautiful to me.

zh: 别担心，一切都将被妥善照顾。
en: Don't worry, everything will be taken care of properly.

zh: 将每一天视为生命最珍贵的礼物。
en: Honor every day as a precious gift.

zh: 你拥有神奇的力量，大胆去创造。
en: You have the magical power to create boldly.

zh: 我陪伴你在任何阶段，包括此时。
en: I accompany you in any stages including at this moment.

zh: 我如此爱你，你更要无条件爱自己。
en: Love yourself unconditionally as love you.

zh: 原谅将为你带来更多向前推动的力量。
en: Forgiveness will empower you to move forward.

zh: 你喜悦的笑容蕴含着生生不息的希望。
en: Your smile projects hope for all time.

zh: 感谢和爱都将为你带来巨大的内在财富。
en: Gratitude and love will return you great inner wealth.

zh: 你专注于什么，能量就给予你所专注的。
en: Concentrate on that which gives you energy.

zh: 不论你如何看待自己的软弱，你依然值得被爱。
en: You deserve love no matter how weak you feel.

zh: 在宇宙的能量中，没有对错分别，也不带框架与批判。
en: In the energy of the universe there is no distinction between right and wrong and there is no framework and criticism.

zh: 全然的信任，我会将对你最合适的所有带来你的面前。
en: With complete confidence I bring you anything you need.

zh: 信任生命中的所有事件，都有宇宙神圣秩序的完美安排。
en: Everything is unfolding perfectly according to a divine order so trust all events in life.

zh: 所有你感觉不可预的事，都在为你带来最高意图的学习。
en: Everything you feel unpredictable is bringing you learning with the highest intention.

zh: 你无须向任何人证明你的价值，你的存在就是无上的价值。
en: You don't need to prove your worth to anyone, your existence is of supreme value.

zh: 用光与爱的能量去服务他人，回流的正面能量将出乎你意料之外。
en: Be of service to others and you will be surprised by the positive energy returned to you.
